node.text: Create a routine to reuse a training plan
Build a strength program with guided exercise and Training Max setup.
Name the days here. Choose exercises and assistance roles separately.
Add only the exercises used in this day. The complete library stays in the picker.
Copies the performed exercises and set details into this day as editable prescriptions; it does not alter the original workout.
